plan.title: PR cart quantity, UOM, removal, and count

steps.note: Open the purchase requisitions flow containing the project cart.
Use an open purchase request, which can be selected for project creation.
Select a purchase request with at least two line items so quantity, UOM, removal, and remaining-count behavior can be tested.

args.goal: open the selected purchase request's eRFX Project cart, edit one line's quantity, open its UOM dropdown, search for and select a different UOM, remove another line with its trash control, and stop with the cart showing the updated quantity and UOM, the removed row absent, and the Create Project button count matching the remaining selected rows

steps.note: Perform and verify the cart-only interactions that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Confirm the cart ends with the Create Project control visible for the remaining items.
